build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run stage-workers

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop-native website reverse engineering and blueprinting tool.
bundle.longDescription: Artupski ReSite is a local-first desktop tool that crawls a website you own or are authorized to test, produces a structured Blueprint of its pages/components/design system, synthesizes React components, generates a buildable Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind project, and exports it with documentation. All processing is local; no public websites are contacted by the test suite.
